Each explicit external_assumptions list refers to the exact inherited assumption records below. No version is merged away because its natural-statement hash is unchanged.
assessment_policy.source_scope: Source scopes are source-faithful mathematical transcriptions, not quotations of registered summaries and not claims that the sourced statements are proved correctly.

The mathematical nodes cite reference manuscripts, not independent Argus proof/checker artifacts. The old report's declared verification was limited to G volume and the locally-klt-type and perturbation-chamber extensions, assigned to other units. Empty assumption arrays mean no assumptions recorded in that version, not an assumption-free proof.

A_DPS_STRUCTURE.statement: The universal cover and finite-cover Albanese structure for a compact Kahler manifold with Hermitian semipositive anticanonical bundle underlies the compact-monodromy construction.
A_DPS_STRUCTURE.source: Demailly-Peternell-Schneider, Compact Kahler manifolds with hermitian semipositive anticanonical bundle, Compositio Mathematica 101 (1996), 217-224, Structure Theorem, p. 218; https://www.numdam.org/item/CM_1996__101_2_217_0/. Recorded as context, not independently checked in this bounded mission.

A_CDP_RATIONAL_CONNECTEDNESS.statement: The remaining compact factor in the semipositive Ricci structure theorem is rationally connected under the hypotheses of Campana-Demailly-Peternell Theorem 1.4.
A_CDP_RATIONAL_CONNECTEDNESS.source: Campana-Demailly-Peternell, Rationally connected manifolds and semipositivity of the Ricci curvature; version identified in the staged bibliography.

A_HARD_LEFSCHETZ.statement: Hard Lefschetz with multiplier ideals produces twisted forms for the semipositive coefficient under its compact Kahler hypotheses.
A_HARD_LEFSCHETZ.source: Demailly-Peternell-Schneider, Pseudo-effective line bundles on compact Kahler manifolds, explicitly versioned in the staged bibliography.

A_BCHM_NONVANISHING.statement: Nonvanishing for the effective big klt boundary constructed in E applies when its log canonical divisor is pseudoeffective. This assumption retains the effective, big, and klt premises.
A_BCHM_NONVANISHING.source: Birkar-Cascini-Hacon-McKernan, Existence of minimal models for varieties of log general type, cited as BCHM2010, Theorem D in E introduction. It is not a premise of the bounded volume theorem.

A_ADJOINT_FINITE_GENERATION.statement: The multigraded adjoint ring of the effective klt rational boundaries and common ample rational divisor used in E is finitely generated; finite-index multigraded Veronese subrings preserve finite generation.
A_ADJOINT_FINITE_GENERATION.source: Corti-Lazic (2013), Theorem 3.2(1) and Lemma 3.1, as explicitly invoked in E correction-ring.tex; underlying Cascini-Lazic adjoint-ring theorem. Exact primary-source attribution remains outside this bounded theorem.

A_BIRATIONAL_TOROIDALIZATION.statement: A characteristic-zero projective morphism can be made toroidal by projective birational source and base modifications; this does not assert reduced fibers without alteration.
A_BIRATIONAL_TOROIDALIZATION.source: Abramovich-Denef-Karu, Weak toroidalization over non-closed fields, Manuscripta Mathematica 142 (2013), 257-271, cited in G. The exact theorem and projective equidimensional refinement are separate hypotheses to check.

A_TOROIDAL_EQUIDIMENSIONAL_REFINEMENT.statement: The toroidal subdivision step used in the applications achieves an equidimensional normal toroidal model; reduced fibers after alteration are a different construction.
A_TOROIDAL_EQUIDIMENSIONAL_REFINEMENT.source: Abramovich-Karu, Weak semistable reduction in characteristic 0, Inventiones Mathematicae 139 (2000), 241-273; G bibliography explicitly locates Proposition 4.4 and Lemma 4.1 in the first arXiv version.

claims.registered_statement: For every smooth connected projective complex variety X whose anticanonical bundle admits a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric, H^0(X,-mK_X) is nonzero for some integer m>0 (H, thm:headline). Alternative proofs are recorded as separate routes, not simultaneous prerequisites.
claims.source_scope: For every smooth connected projective complex X with a smooth Hermitian metric of semipositive curvature on -K_X, some integer m>0 has H^0(X,-mK_X) nonzero. The source does not replace smooth semipositivity by nefness or promise m=1.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Independently validate one complete source route, including the needed invariant factor section, compact-monodromy descent and finite norm. A conditional G volume result does not by itself establish the headline theorem.

claims.registered_statement: If Z is smooth connected projective with H^0(Z,Omega_Z^q)=0 for all q>0, D is effective integral, -K_Z+D has a semipositive singular metric with finite canonical-section measure, and L has locally bounded semipositive weights, then H^0(Z,aL+bD) is nonzero for some integers a>0,b>=0 (H, thm:finite-volume).
claims.source_scope: Z is smooth connected projective complex of dimension d and H^0(Z,Omega_Z^q)=0 for every 1<=q<=d. D>=0 is integral. J=-K_Z+D has a semipositive singular Hermitian metric with integral_Z |s_D|^2 finite. A separate line bundle L has a semipositive singular metric with weights locally bounded on both sides. Then H^0(Z,aL+bD) is nonzero for some integers a>0,b>=0. No uniform bound on b is asserted.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate the dimension induction, finite-volume slope input, hard Lefschetz use and controlled-pole two-metric lifting while retaining distinct singular volume and bounded target metrics. The registered G transfer dependency is not a prerequisite on G toroidal volume.

claims.registered_statement: The finite-adjoint-volume slope estimate used in H controls cotangent determinants on a supporting movable class and permits the dimension induction; this is a source-specific audit obligation, not an assumed consequence of nefness.

source_attribution.registration_relation: Descriptive induction obligation synthesizing the theorem and supporting-face corollary; not a single verbatim source statement.

claims.source_scope: For smooth connected projective complex Z, integral D>=0, and semipositive singular J=-K_Z+D with finite canonical-section measure, every nonzero real movable alpha satisfies mu_min,alpha(T_Z)>=-D.alpha when dim Z>0. For every integer k>=0 and nonzero M -> (Omega_Z^1)^(tensor k), -M+kD is pseudoeffective; for a rank-r>0 torsion-free subsheaf E, -det E+krD is pseudoeffective. No no-forms premise is in this theorem. The face corollary additionally assumes dim Z>0, L pseudoeffective and L+D not big; it supplies nonzero movable alpha with L.alpha=D.alpha=0, and, for the displayed M and effective N_i~M+m_iL, M.alpha=N_i.alpha=0 and nonbigness of their finite nonnegative combinations with D.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the finite-adjoint-volume-to-foliation/slope argument and its tensor and determinant conclusions for all nonzero real movable classes, then the supporting-face application. Numerical nefness alone is not the registered analytic input.

claims.registered_statement: The H orbit-transfer argument produces a naturally torus-invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple on its smooth no-positive-forms factor, using invariant adjoint ranks and compact averaging rather than the full-rank volume theorem.

source_attribution.registration_relation: Mechanism summary with a direct natural-invariant-nonvanishing theorem counterpart.

claims.source_scope: Smooth connected projective complex Z has H^0(Z,Omega_Z^q)=0 for all q>0 and smoothly semipositive L=-K_Z. A compact connected real torus T acts continuously by holomorphic automorphisms, with the natural differential-induced linearization on L. Then H^0(Z,mL)^T is nonzero for some integer m>0. The separate invariant transfer proposition takes D=0, equivariant maps and compatible linearizations, trivial base action, invariant relative sections, smooth semipositive invariant metrics, and invariant generic adjoint dimension one for every j>=0.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the quotient construction, invariant generic adjoint ranks and compact-averaging orthogonal holomorphic quotient positivity, followed by invariant lifting. This smooth invariant argument cannot be certified by a full-rank singular volume theorem alone.

claims.registered_statement: The finite-cover compact-torus-monodromy structure in H retains the deck action on the universal-cover factors; it is not a global-product assertion for a finite cover.
claims.source_scope: For smooth connected projective complex X with smoothly semipositive -K_X, there is a connected finite etale cover S->X and an isometric holomorphic universal-cover decomposition C^a x F x Z. Compact F,Z are simply connected and projective; F is Ricci-flat with a parallel nowhere-zero canonical section, Z has smoothly semipositive -K_Z, no positive-degree holomorphic forms and H^q(O_Z)=0 for q>0, and is rationally connected if positive-dimensional. A full lattice Lambda acts by (z,f,v)->(z+lambda,f,rho(lambda)v). The closure of rho(Lambda) is a compact connected real torus T, possibly trivial, extending to an algebraic torus G with T Zariski dense and identical natural anticanonical invariant spaces for all m>=0. The C^a and F canonical frames are deck-invariant. Factors may be points. S is this quotient, not necessarily a global product.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate the DPS/CDP-based structure reduction and the finite-index compact connected residual monodromy, torus extension and deck-invariant canonical frames. Retaining a potentially infinite monodromy action is essential; a finite global-product assertion would be a different claim.

claims.registered_statement: A nonzero section of a positive tensor power of a pulled-back line on a finite etale cover gives a nonzero section of a positive tensor power on the base by the finite etale norm.
claims.source_scope: For a finite etale morphism nu:S->X of degree d>0 between smooth connected projective complex varieties and a line bundle A on X, every nonzero s in H^0(S,nu^*A) has a nonzero norm in H^0(X,A^(tensor d)). In particular a section of K_S^(-m), m>0, gives one of K_X^(-md).
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: An independent check of the global norm construction, its nonvanishing and degree-d exponent in the descent application was not supplied by the old inventory and is not undertaken here. This source lemma is not claimed as an original Argus result.

claims.registered_statement: For a holomorphic action of a compact real torus T on a compact complex manifold F and the natural anticanonical linearization, I_T(m)=sum_q(-1)^q dim H^q(F,(-K_F)^m)^T agrees with a rational polynomial P at every positive multiple of some a>0, and P(0)=I_T(0); no positivity, Kahlerness, or projectivity is assumed (I, thm:index).
claims.source_scope: T is a compact real torus acting holomorphically on compact complex F; -K_F has its natural differential-induced linearization. Define I_T(m)=sum_q (-1)^q dim H^q(F,(-K_F)^m)^T. There exist integer a>0 and P in Q[t] such that I_T(m)=P(m) for every positive multiple m of a and P(0)=I_T(0), the actual invariant structure-sheaf Euler characteristic. There is no positivity, Kahlerness or projectivity assumption, and the theorem is not merely eventual polynomiality.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Independently check the localization/weighted deleted-face calculation at every divisible positive exponent and its value at zero. Natural anticanonical character data must be retained; eventual polynomiality or arbitrary character-shifted linearization would not establish this statement.

claims.registered_statement: If S is smooth connected projective, L=-K_S is smoothly semipositive, D is a fixed pseudoeffective Cartier divisor, and H^0(S,m_jL-D) is nonzero along a strictly increasing positive sequence, then H^0(S,kL) is nonzero for some k>0 (I, thm:conversion).
claims.source_scope: S is smooth connected projective complex, L=-K_S has a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric, and fixed D is a pseudoeffective Cartier divisor. Nonzero H^0(S,O_S(m_jL-D)) for a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers implies nonzero H^0(S,O_S(kL)) for some integer k>0. D need not be effective, and no group action, rational-connectedness or Euler-characteristic condition is assumed.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the maximal dominated base, rank-one adjoint normalization, bounded base metric and exponent-zero Euler-polynomial conversion to a section of the actual positive anticanonical power, without adding an effectiveness or Euler premise.

claims.registered_statement: For a projective Q-factorial klt pair (W,D) with effective rational boundary, nef P=-(K_W+D), and a smooth projective resolution rho on which rho^*P has locally bounded semipositive weights and chi(O) is nonzero, a positive Cartier multiple of P has a nonzero section (B, thm:klt).
claims.source_scope: (W,D) is a projective Q-factorial klt pair with effective rational boundary, P=-(K_W+D) is nef, and a smooth projective resolution rho:W_tilde->W has a semipositive metric with locally bounded weights on rho^*P and chi(W_tilde,O_W_tilde) nonzero. Then H^0(W,O_W(mP)) is nonzero for some integer m>0 with mP Cartier. Locally bounded weights need not be continuous.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate the bounded-metric nonvanishing argument, discrepancy rounding and Euler interpolation under the effective rational boundary, Q-factorial klt, nefness, resolution metric and nonzero resolution Euler hypotheses. This is not a registered theorem for arbitrary nef klt pairs.

claims.registered_statement: If Z is smooth rationally connected projective and -K_Z is smoothly semipositive, every algebraic torus acting on Z has a naturally invariant section of some positive anticanonical multiple (B, thm:equivariant). Its stable-quotient metric and extension are separate obligations from toroidal volume.
claims.source_scope: For smooth rationally connected projective Z with a smooth semipositive Hermitian anticanonical metric, every algebraic torus T acting on Z has H^0(Z,-mK_Z)^T nonzero for some integer m>0, for the natural differential-induced anticanonical linearization. The auxiliary quotient linearization is not a replacement for this natural one.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Construct and check the stable quotient, effective klt stabilizer boundary, bounded quotient metric, nonzero resolution Euler characteristic and extension preserving the original natural character. G toroidal volume is not the registered sufficient proof of these quotient-specific hypotheses.

claims.registered_statement: For smooth connected projective X with smoothly semipositive L=-K_X and an algebraic torus action, let P=L as ordinary lines with any linearization and let M be linearized with -M pseudoeffective. Nonzero invariant sections of M+iP for an unbounded positive set of i imply a nonzero invariant section of mP for some m>0 (C, inj:transfer).
claims.source_scope: X is smooth connected projective, L=-K_X carries a smooth semipositive metric, and algebraic torus T acts on X. P,M are T-linearized line bundles with P=L as ordinary line bundles and -M pseudoeffective. P may differ from the natural linearization by a character. For an unbounded I subset Z_{>0}, nonzero invariant s_i in H^0(X,M+iP)^T for every i in I imply H^0(X,mP)^T nonzero for some integer m>0, preserving that specified linearization. No H^1 or Euler-characteristic condition is assumed.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate character-sensitive ratio-field transfer, the fixed multiplier ideal, exponent-zero section detection and invariant return map for the specified possibly shifted P and unbounded I. I's natural-linearization index theorem cannot automatically supply input for every shifted P.

claims.registered_statement: For the C harmonic mechanism, f:V->Y is a surjective morphism of smooth projective varieties, D_V has a smooth semipositive metric whose null directions are vertical on a nonempty submersion open, and Q has a continuous semipositive metric on Y. Then H^p(Y,R^q f_*(K_V+D_V) tensor Q^k)=0 for p>0 and q,k>=0. This is an alternative mechanism, not an input to g:toroidal-volume.
claims.source_scope: f:V->Y is a surjective morphism of smooth connected projective complex varieties. D_V is a line bundle with a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric of curvature theta. Q on Y has a positive continuous Hermitian metric with psh weights. On a nonempty ordinary open subset of the submersion locus require ker(theta) subset ker(df). Then H^p(Y,R^q f_*(K_V+D_V) tensor Q^k)=0 for every p>0, q>=0, k>=0.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check continuous-base approximation, harmonic restriction and the vanishing conclusion with the kernel condition explicitly supplied by a particular diagram. Do not infer the kernel condition from nefness or use a decomposition theorem for a merely continuous coefficient upstairs. This is an alternative mechanism, not a G-volume premise.

claims.registered_statement: For g:transfer, two semipositive metrics, finite canonical-section volume, a rational relative section without horizontal poles on a normal equidimensional model, and the two explicitly assumed psh fiber functions produce a bounded base line metric and an integral controlled-pole adjoint measure. Full-rank-one and invariant-quotient sufficient conditions must not be conflated.

source_attribution.model_setup_retained: The diagram is prepared from a dominant rational map with connected general fibers; the normal intermediate model is equidimensional, not necessarily its smooth resolution W. In the rank-one condition J=K_{W/V}.

claims.source_scope: V is smooth connected projective, D>=0 integral, A=-K_V+D has a semipositive singular metric with finite canonical-section measure, and L has a semipositive metric with bounded weights. Use a normal projective birational intermediate model with surjective equidimensional map to smooth projective Y, a smooth resolution W, and 0<dim Y<=dim V. A nonzero rational section rho of kL, k>0, has no horizontal poles on the normal model. On a dense base open, -log(g_0) for f_*p^*mu and -log(S_rho) for the fiber essential supremum of |p^*rho|^2 have psh representatives. After clearing a positive denominator there are bounded semipositive B, effective integral D_Y and regular nonzero f^*B->bk p^*L, b>0; -K_Y+D_Y has a semipositive finite distinguished adjoint measure. Every nonzero section of aB+cD_Y, integers a>0,c>=0, lifts to a nonzero rational section of abkL with poles only on D; invariant data and rho over a trivial torus base preserve invariance. The sufficient full generic rank condition is h^0(W_eta,(J+p^*D+mk p^*L)|W_eta)=1 for every m>=0. Its invariant version separately requires D=0, smooth invariant metrics, invariant rho and invariant dimensions one.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check normal-model order normalization, the two psh fiber-function hypotheses or a source-appropriate sufficient condition, boundedness across boundary, finite adjoint volume and controlled-pole lifting. Full generic rank with singular coefficients and the smooth invariant quotient are distinct sufficient regimes, neither automatically supplied by another unit.

claims.registered_statement: For smooth connected projective no-positive-forms X with smoothly semipositive -K_X and a torus, a T-invariant rational fibration with relatively algebraically closed base field, a generic positive anticanonical invariant section, and invariant generic adjoint rank one at all positive multiples of one integer either gives a global invariant section or contracts through a strictly smaller smooth projective base retaining both conditions and relative algebraic closedness (G, g:cf:contraction-theorem).
claims.source_scope: X is smooth connected projective complex, H^0(X,Omega_X^q)=0 for q>0, L=-K_X is smoothly semipositive, and algebraic torus T acts naturally on L. The dominant invariant rational map f:X->Z has smooth connected projective base Z with C(Z) relatively algebraically closed in C(X). On a smooth resolution pi:Y->X, f_Y:Y->Z, put L_Y=pi^*L and E_Y=K_{Y/X}. The complete generic fiber has a nonzero invariant section of pL_Y for some integer p>0, and its invariant H^0(E_Y+mL_Y) has dimension one over C(Z) for every positive multiple of some integer a>0. Either H^0(X,rL)^T is nonzero for some r>0, or a dominant rational h:Z->W with dim W<dim Z and W smooth connected projective gives the same two conditions for h o f, possibly with different integers, and C(W) relatively algebraically closed in C(X).
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate preservation of the generic invariant section, invariant adjoint rank at all required positive multiples and relative algebraic closedness under the strictly dimension-lowering contraction. The rank is invariant rank, not full ordinary rank; conditional volume positivity alone does not provide the contraction.

claims.registered_statement: If Y is smooth projective of positive dimension, C>=0 is integral, and -K_Y+C has a singular metric with curvature dominating a Kahler form and multiplier ideal containing O_Y(-C), then every pseudoeffective rational divisor M becomes rationally effective after adding an effective rational divisor supported on C (E, thm:controlled-boundary).
claims.source_scope: Y is smooth projective complex of positive dimension, C>=0 is integral, and -K_Y+C has a singular Hermitian metric whose curvature globally dominates a Kahler form and whose multiplier ideal contains O_Y(-C). For every pseudoeffective rational divisor M there is an effective rational C_0 supported on C such that M+C_0 is rationally linearly equivalent to an effective rational divisor. This is weighted canonical-section integrability, not the unweighted frame-integrability premise of the correction-ring theorem.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the controlled-support construction of an effective big klt boundary, the global strict metric/weighted ideal premise and the BCHM nonvanishing invocation yielding actual rational linear effectivity. Local strictness or numerical effectivity alone is not this theorem's input or output.

claims.registered_statement: If -K_Y+A_0 on smooth positive-dimensional projective Y has a semipositive singular metric with unweighted integrable squared frame norms, smooth and strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary open, then for any finite list of rational divisors P_i some common rational epsilon>0 and k_0>0 give Cartier B_i=k_0(A_0+epsilon P_i) whose actual multigraded section ring is finitely generated (E, thm:correction-ring).
claims.source_scope: Y is smooth projective of positive dimension and A_0 is a rational divisor. -K_Y+A_0 has a semipositive singular metric with unweighted locally integrable squared frame norms, smooth and strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary open set. For any finite rational divisors P_1,...,P_s there are common epsilon in Q_{>0} and integer k_0>0 such that the actual B_i=k_0(A_0+epsilon P_i) are Cartier and the N^s-graded direct sum of H^0(Y,O_Y(sum a_i B_i)) is a finitely generated C-algebra. No effectiveness premise on A_0 is stated in this theorem; actual rational linear divisors, not only numerical classes, are retained.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the integrable-neighborhood construction, common rational perturbation, effective klt adjoint representatives and identification with the actual finitely generated multigraded ring after a common Cartier/Veronese choice. Weighted section integrability alone does not discharge the unweighted frame premise.

claims.registered_statement: E obtains ordinary fixed-pseudoeffective-error conversion for smoothly semipositive -K_X. Its main singular globally-strict metric route and its smooth toroidal/unweighted route are alternatives; failure of g:toroidal-volume alone does not refute the main conversion or headline nonvanishing.

source_attribution.registration_relation: Route-independence summary, not a single theorem quotation. Its ordinary conversion theorem is identified explicitly.

claims.source_scope: The precise conversion theorem assumes smooth connected projective complex X, smoothly semipositive L=-K_X, fixed pseudoeffective Cartier divisor P, and effective integral N_j~m_jL-P for unbounded positive integers m_j. It concludes H^0(X,mL) nonzero for some positive integer m. The main construction uses a singular globally-strict metric and weighted controlled boundary; the smooth toroidal/unweighted construction is an alternative for the same base and conclusion, not an additional simultaneous prerequisite.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Validate one chosen metric route on the Iitaka/dominated base and removal of its controlled exceptional correction to obtain a section of the actual positive anticanonical power. Neither route is verified here; a failure of G toroidal volume alone would not dispose of the main singular globally-strict route.

claims.registered_statement: For smooth connected positive-dimensional projective X with smoothly semipositive L=-K_X of maximum curvature rank nu and ample G_0, put ell(D)=D.L^nu.G_0^(n-nu-1) when nu<n and ell=0 otherwise. For any fixed line M, any centered discrete valuation v of C(X) or v=0, and effective integral N_j~m_j L+M with m_j->infinity, ell(N_j)=0 and v(N_j)/m_j->0, there is effective rational N~_Q L with v(N)=0 (V, V:exact).
claims.source_scope: X is smooth connected projective complex of dimension n>0, L=-K_X has a fixed smooth semipositive curvature alpha representing c_1(L), nu is its maximum complex rank, and G_0 is ample. ell(D)=D.L^nu.G_0^(n-nu-1) if nu<n and ell=0 if nu=n. For any fixed line bundle M and either a centered discrete valuation v of C(X) or the zero valuation, suppose effective integral N_j~m_jL+M with positive integers m_j tending to infinity have ell(N_j)=0 and v(N_j)/m_j tending to zero. Then there is an effective rational N rationally linearly equivalent to L with v(N)=0. No irregularity, Euler-characteristic or pseudoeffectivity condition on -M is assumed.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Check the full null-polar-field/model/rank/curvature application, the correction-ring input and actual rational-linear endpoint selection for a centered discrete or zero valuation. G's conditional volume theorem, numerical limiting effectivity or a finite search cannot alone prove exact attainment.

claims.registered_statement: The V null-polar-field construction supplies a normal equidimensional toroidal model with full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero and a patch of horizontal curvature domination, as required by g:toroidal-volume. This application interface remains a separate obligation from that theorem.

source_attribution.registration_relation: Several geometric and analytic source steps synthesized as an application interface; not a theorem asserting that any toroidal model automatically has rank one and horizontal strictness.

claims.source_scope: Using X,L,alpha,nu,G_0,ell of V:exact, k={0} union {h in C(X)^*:ell((h)_infinity)=0} is claimed finitely generated and relatively algebraically closed. For smooth models X<-Z->Y of C(Y)=k, every very ample H on Y has ell(pi_*g^*H)=0 and the full generic space H^0(Z_eta,O_Z(K_{Z/X})|Z_eta) has dimension one over C(Y). For dim Y>0 the source constructs normal projective W, birational p:W->X and surjective equidimensional toroidal f:W->Y for strict toroidal embeddings, without base field extension; the smooth resolution need not be equidimensional. At a nonempty maximum-rank smooth base-change patch away from the Jacobian divisor, it claims pi^*alpha>=c g^*omega_H for c>0. These inputs are used to invoke G volume and obtain effective rational A_0 with p_*f^*A_0=0 and an unweighted integrable metric on -K_Y+A_0, smooth and strictly positive on an ordinary open. Rank and the patch are application obligations, not automatic outputs of toroidalization or of G's conditional theorem.
claims.out_of_scope_unresolved_obligation: Independently verify finite generation and relative algebraic closedness of the null-polar field, full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero, projective birational toroidal/equidimensional preparation without changing that field, and a horizontal domination patch away from the Jacobian divisor.
